company.description: TeamViewer focuses on cloud-based technologies to enable online remote support and collaboration globally. aiResearchSummary.text: TeamViewer is researching methods for piloting a remote device with a local device, as described in 'Computer implemented method for piloting a remote device with a local device,' which details controlling a remote device with a smaller screen from a local device with a larger screen. This area of development aligns with remote access and support, focusing on enhancing device interaction and control across different screen sizes.
